svg.text: Columns 40 and 50 · same build as channel A, shifted 30 columns right
Centre channel — separates top from bottom
Every hole in a column from a to e is connected — which is why column 50
carries the 100 kΩ, both diodes and the signal line at the same time.
The black band of both diodes points up. That is not a coincidence but the
mnemonic: once towards 3V3, once towards the signal node.
